why: In JSON the raw byte is not the vector, because JSON.parse refuses it. The vector is the format escape: a unicode escape of ESC inside a string is clean text on disk and a real ESC after parsing, in whatever the client prints. The fail side is config.json with that escape in a description. The pass side has the same characters preceded by an escaped backslash, which decodes to a literal backslash and the text after it, not to a control: a rule that ignored backslash parity would fail every regex pattern and Windows path stored in JSON.
